newsitem.title: USA: Washington Post stake held by Southeastern.
newsitem.headline: Washington Post stake held by Southeastern.

text.p: A group led by Southeastern Asset Management Inc said in a Securities and Exchange Commission filing Tuesday it holds a 6.5 percent stake in Washington Post Co or 591,051 common shares.
Southeastern, a Memphis, Tenn.,-based investment adviser, disclosed its latest position on the Washington Post in a 13G filing.
Filings under 13G are usually made by institutions and large investors with "passive" investment objectives in a company. Unlike 13D filings, those reports do not list the latest transactions.

The Washington Post Co, based in Washington, DC., is engaged in the publication of newspapers, magazines and books and television broadcasting and cable television, educational test preparation and on-line legislative services.
